purpose: Exercise the proposed capture discriminator and epoch relabelling argument without implementing native restore or changing World.
initial_source_epochs: Every current epoch from zero through mask; every three-cell stamp tuple in [0,current]. Zero-current inputs represent a fresh tick-zero World.
destination_epochs: Every nonzero destination current epoch; map touched cells to destination current and all others to zero, retaining logical contents and absolute tick.
invariants: no future stamps under full resident clear
negative_models: clear only active cells and leave an excluded old stamp at wrap
qualification_limits: Small-width exhaustive contract model, not native execution, production serializer, full material/geometry/scheduler equivalence, E8/E16 natural-rollover evidence, or acceptance of lazy clearing.
acceptance_class: contract-model author validation pending independent review
